verdict.rationale: PagerDuty publishes a well-documented REST API, Events API v2, V3 webhooks, and an official MCP server, all confirmed live via runtime probes (401 auth challenge on MCP endpoint, structured validation errors on Events API), demonstrating genuine programmatic access beyond marketing claims. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically praising API completeness/documentation quality beyond PagerDuty's own docs.
